variables.name: Last Menstrual Period

variables.description: Average number of days between periods (default 28)

stepByStep: Enter the first day of your last menstrual period (or conception date).
Adjust cycle length if your typical menstrual cycle differs from 28 days.

workedExample.title: Due Date Calculation Example
workedExample.scenario: First day of last period was January 1 with a regular 28-day cycle.
workedExample.calculation: Add 1 year, subtract 3 months, add 7 days (or add 280 days).

faqs.question: How accurate is the estimated due date (EDD)?
faqs.answer: Only about 4-5% of babies are born exactly on their due date; most arrive within two weeks before or after.

faqs.question: What are the three trimesters?
faqs.answer: First trimester: weeks 1-13. Second trimester: weeks 14-27. Third trimester: week 28 to birth.

en.notes: Adds 280 days (40 weeks) to the first day of the last menstrual period (LMP) assuming a 28-day cycle.

faqs.question: गर्भावस्था के तीन ट्राइमेस्टर क्या हैं?
faqs.answer: पहला: सप्ताह 1-13, दूसरा: सप्ताह 14-27, तीसरा: सप्ताह 28 से जन्म तक।

faqs.question: ¿Cómo se dividen los trimestres?

faqs.answer: 予定日当日に出産を迎える赤ちゃんは約5%で、妊娠37週〜41週（正期産）での出産が一般的です。

faqs.question: 妊娠期間の3区分とは？
faqs.answer: 妊娠初期（1〜13週）、妊娠中期（14〜27週）、妊娠後期（28週〜出産）に分類されます。

faqs.question: Quelle est la différence entre SA et SG ?
faqs.answer: Les semaines d’aménorrhée (SA) se comptent depuis les dernières règles, les semaines de grossesse (SG) depuis la fécondation (environ SA - 2).

faqs.question: Combien de bébés naissent le jour du terme ?
faqs.answer: Moins de 5 % des nouveau-nés arrivent précisément le jour de la DPA.

fr.notes: Ajoute 280 jours (ou 41 SA selon les recommandations françaises) au premier jour des dernières règles.
